mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO meeting_vote_candidate (start_time, end_time, meeting_id) VALUES
(#{candidate.startTime}, #{candidate.endTime}, #{meetingId})
mapper.select: SELECT mvc.meeting_candidate_id, mvc.start_time, mvc.end_time, COUNT(mvr.meeting_vote_id) AS voteCount FROM meeting_vote_candidate mvc LEFT JOIN meeting_vote_record mvr ON mvc.meeting_candidate_id = mvr.meeting_candidate_id WHERE mvc.meeting_id = #{meetingId} GROUP BY mvc.meeting_candidate_id ORDER BY voteCount DESC
